result:
The fix for #999 is committed and pushed to `develop` as e064b36e, with `Fixes #999`. A grammar rule whose result is a tuple mixing `String` with another type, such as `(String, i64)` or `(String, Value)`, now takes the views its action builds. That also holds when another rule hands the tuple on through a label (`p:Pair -> { p }`).

- **Where the fix came from:** an earlier run of this brief had already left the fix and the test in the tree, then died before committing. I took that work over, rebuilt it on the current `develop` and checked it again.
- **What changed:** before, every part of a tuple counted toward whether it holds a view, so an `i64` or `Value::Num(n)` beside a view made the whole tuple owned. Now only the parts that hold text count, in `text_tiers.nika` and its lowered file.
- **New test:** `grammar_a_mixed_tuple_result_takes_views` fails on the unfixed compiler with the brief's NK1104. Fixed, it prints `ab 12` / `cd num 34`. The existing grammar tuple tests pass.
- **Gate:** green. The guard set passed (24, `sequences` included), clippy is clean and the pre-push check passes.
- **`tests/compiler` at both settings is not fully clean in the shared checkout.** Three runs failed 9, 2 and 8 tests, a different set each time. The repeated failure is an NK2302 refusal of `places` in `tests/compiler/src/main.nika` at one setting only. Other agents were running the same project then (cargo printed file-lock lines). The 12 tests that failed in those runs pass 3 times out of 3 in an isolated copy with the ledger files. So I put the failures down to the concurrent runs, not my change, but I did not prove it.
- **Two failures are not mine:** `grammar_a_guard_reads_a_name_bound_inside_text` comes from commit 03d43063, made after my build. `a_trait_column_change_warns` printed cargo file-lock lines from another run.
- **Disk:** the test cache is at 2.3G (one entry over 100 MB: `run-bundle/2df207096bba39fb`, 286 MB). The disk has 9.5G free and 0 GB was freed.

done e064b36e, report /home/user/Nikaia/docs/briefs/bugs/b1-999-mixed-tuple-views.md.report.md
